What goes on which guitar, and why. Keeps me from buying the wrong pack at Merchant City Music every single time.

## Telecaster (1998 Fender American Standard)

Ernie Ball Regular Slinky 10-46. Tried 9-42 for a summer in 2023 for easier bends and it sounded like a ukulele through a fuzz pedal. Back to 10s. Bends on the B string up a full tone at the 15th fret are fine with 10s once the guitar is warmed up for practice.

## Gibson ES-335 (2011 reissue)

D'Addario EXL115 11-49. Wound G would be nicer for jazz comping but the intonation went sharp by 12 cents at the 12th fret and I couldn't get the saddle back far enough. Plain G stays.

## Acoustic (Lowden O-22)

Elixir Nanoweb phosphor bronze 12-53. £16.50 a set, last about two months even with session work. Worth it on the acoustic, not on the electrics.

## Change schedule and costs

- Electrics: every 3 weeks when gigging, every 6 when not.
- Ernie Ball £7.99, D'Addario £8.49 at Merchant City Music, cheaper in 10-packs online (£62 for ten EXL115, January 2025).
- Logging the spend in the music tab of the [[Budget spreadsheet]].
- Never restring the night before a session (learned on KR-3317, see [[Guitar practice]]).
